description:
[FREE] Every country in the database, with its FIFA code and id.

Use it to turn a country name into the id and FIFA code the rest of the data is keyed
by, or to check which countries are covered at all. Search with `q`, which matches a
name prefix or an exact FIFA code ("ENG"). Countries that no longer exist are included
and flagged, because the match archive still holds their games.

Free: no key needed, and it costs a key holder nothing either.

limit.description: How many countries to return. Default 25; the total is always reported.

q.description: Country name prefix, or an exact FIFA code such as ENG or BRA.

name: list_countries

hint.description: Present only when rows were left out: how to narrow the call.

returned.description: How many rows are in data.

total.description: How many rows matched before the limit.

title: Countries
